messages:
Jordan Patel: hey team :wave: I started today and trying to set up Notion. I can see the onboarding playbook at /handbook/onboarding but there is no Duplicate option for me. Is that intentional or am I missing something?
Priya Nair: welcome Jordan :tada: The playbook is owned by the docs-owners group — duplication is disabled for read-only viewers. Share the link and someone from docs can grant you edit or copy rights.
Jordan Patel: thanks! link: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/onboarding-playbook
Ashley Chen: pinging @Samir — he's the docs steward who handles page perms. Samir can add you to the group or flip the copy setting. :eyes:
Samir Gupta: hey Jordan, added you to docs-owners just now. Can you refresh and check? If you still don't see Duplicate, let me know and I'll set the page-level copy option.
Jordan Patel: refreshed — I can duplicate now, thanks Samir :relieved: Quick follow-up: where do shared templates live? I'm trying to duplicate the Product PRD template into my personal workspace.
Priya Nair: templates are in the Templates library (left sidebar) and we keep canonical ones under /handbook/templates. For the Product PRD it's at: `notion://redwood/handbook/templates/product/PRD-template`
Samir Gupta: FYI our workflow: duplicate the template into your personal space, draft, then move to /handbook/drafts with a short PR describing changes. If you want me to add a new template to the shared library, open a short PR in the docs repo or ping me with the file.
Jordan Patel: got it. One more tiny ask — is there a checklist I should finish after duplicating?
docs-bot: Reminder: please complete the "New hire docs checklist" after duplicating pages — https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/new-hire-checklist. Mark done when completed.
Jordan Patel: perfect, thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
